scope: sys.file.read<T> Windows native exact under candidate34

llvm.observed: file.read<UInt16>() emits a call returning %sollang.enum.t248 and passes that value to describeUInt16, which expects %sollang.enum.t1209. The same unspecialized read symbol is used for Bool. llvm-as rejects the first call at line 1615. Direct-call closure and native execution did not run.

rootCause.classification: missing selfhost sys.file generic scalar intrinsic specialization and lowering
rootCause.semanticEvidence: Managed SemanticCompiler.cs specializes RuntimeReadScalar/RuntimeWriteScalar with a concrete scalar type. The selfhost call path retains the generic sys.file declaration for read<T> and does not materialize a concrete Result<Option<T>, Text> call type: the captured UInt16 and Bool reads both call @sollang_m10_s77() returning %sollang.enum.t248.
rootCause.emitterEvidence: The captured LLVM also calls @sollang_m10_s73_g117504 and @sollang_m10_s73_g117507 for scalar writes. No definition or declaration for these generic sys.file read/write targets exists in the captured module. selfhost/llvm/text/platform_io.slg handles owned File readAt/writeAt opcodes -220/-221, which are distinct from global sys.file read/write.
rootCause.requiredFix: Resolve the global sys.file generic scalar intrinsics to concrete scalar and Result/Option types, lower their calls to runtime operations for open/write/close and open/read/close, and verify exact native output including EOF, truncated scalar and invalid Bool encoding before promotion.
